structured_output.what_is_happening: A cluster of "MuseXT" tokens was launched within minutes of each other (at least 11 contracts). The leader looks like the pump.fun version DVby...pump: created about 10 minutes before this one, at $490k market cap with $1.13M hourly volume. This coin is a Meteora pair created about 6 minutes after that leader. It shows $1.7M of volume on a $75k market cap (turnover about 28x). It has about 1,676 unique buyers but only 95 unique sellers. GMGN tags 100 bundler wallets, with top bundler trader share at 65%. Its LP is 100% unlocked. The price has already dropped from its high ($1.03e-4) to $7.5e-5. I could not find the underlying story ("usemusext" X handle; maybe tied to Meta's Muse AI agent, which was in the news on 9/23), and nothing referencing this contract turned up.

narrative.description: Unclear 'MuseXT' project, with a linked X handle @usemusext. It may piggyback on Meta's Muse AI agent news (CNN, 2026-09-23), but I could not verify the link.
narrative.why_spreading: The many same-name copies suggest a real X launch or a tweet that launch bots are copying, but I could not access the X account (HTTP 402) and search found nothing.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the shared name and the X handle given by GeckoTerminal. It is not the first or the largest MuseXT.
token_connection.competing_tokens: DVbyFeAZCaLjg1SrjyF4M6nPj1B3MvVH4Ue8Gmwbpump ($490k mcap, $1.13M h1 vol, created ~10 min earlier) looks like the canonical one. At least 9 other copies exist, most already at zero liquidity.

authenticity.evidence: 100 GMGN-tagged bundler wallets, with top bundler trader share at 65%. Unique buyers outnumber unique sellers about 18 to 1 (1,676 vs 95) while there are 2,836 sell transactions, which points to a few wallets dumping into bot buys. Volume of $1.7M on a $75k market cap looks like wash trading. This is a copycat launched on Meteora (not pump.fun), with no DexScreener profile and no socials of its own.
authenticity.uncertainty: I had no X access, so I can't rule out that the project itself endorsed this contract.

structural_risks: LP 100% unlocked on a Meteora pool; the creator can pull it
Copycat of a larger canonical token

structured_output.counterargument: Meteora launches with official X handles are sometimes the real launch from the project team. If @usemusext endorses this CA, it could re-rate toward the pump.fun twin's $490k (6x). Mint and freeze are renounced, and the top 10 holders own only 23%.

source_coverage.notes: Contract and name searches returned nothing relevant. X profile fetch returned 402. Short on time, so I skipped Reddit, Telegram and Discord.

structured_output.thesis: A bundled copycat MuseXT on Meteora with unlocked LP. The pump.fun twin at $490k is where the attention is. The heavy volume looks manufactured and the price is already off its high. High rug risk, low runner chance.
